releases.notes:
Every schematic now has its own fully customizable HUD.

**HUD editor** (`M + J` or *Customize HUD* in the planner)
- **Look:** custom title (empty = schematic name), 7 themes, every color editable by hex code or by clicking its swatch, background opacity.
- **Elements:** turn every part of the HUD on or off (title, progress, current box, totals, 9x3 box view, legend, missing items, items to remove, status line, reminders). Quick views: Full, Shulker box, List only, Minimal, Reminders only.
- **Layout:** size 50% - 250%, compact mode, padding, text shadow, side bar, border, how many items/reminders to show, stacks or plain numbers.
- Resize the HUD by dragging its bottom right corner or with the mouse wheel.
- Save a style as the default for new schematics.

The old global HUD options are carried over automatically.

Requires Minecraft 26.3, Fabric Loader 0.19+, Litematica 0.29.1+, MaLiLib 0.30.2+.

mods.description: Litematica addon that turns a material list into a ready-to-fill shulker box plan, with a packing assistant, an in-game HUD and a to-do list.

releases.notes:
- The HUD shows the box you're filling as a real shulker box interface (9x3), each slot colored by state:
  inside, in your inventory ready to put in, partially there, missing.
- Three HUD views: Shulker box, Compact (only what's missing) and both. Amounts can be shown as stacks or as plain numbers.
- The HUD tracks the contents of the box live while it's open, keeps them after closing it,
  and also recognizes a partially filled box carried in the inventory.
- Inventory changes are reflected on the HUD every tick.
- The HUD can be dragged anywhere with the mouse (Move HUD button or `M + J`). The view and counts can be switched from the same screen.
- The HUD title is the name of the schematic.
- The HUD follows the placement selected in Litematica when it already has a saved project.
- New hotkeys: move the HUD, cycle the HUD view.

releases.notes:
First release of Shulker Planner for **Minecraft 26.3** (Fabric).

### Requirements
- Fabric Loader 0.19+
- [Litematica](https://modrinth.com/mod/litematica) 0.29.1+
- [MaLiLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/malilib) 0.30.2+ and Fabric API
- Mod Menu is optional

### What's in it
- Shulker box plan from any Litematica material list: Smart, Sequential and One item per box modes.
- Options: full stacks, filling empty slots with spares, and box colors.
- Packing assistant on the shulker box screen, with green/red slot highlights. A box is marked ready when it's complete.
- In-game HUD (`M + H`): progress, the box you're filling with the missing items, and your reminders.
- Materials page: include/exclude, gathered, Total / Missing / To gather, multiplier.
- Reminders page, with notes for materials and boxes.
- Filled boxes in your inventory are detected automatically.
- Creative mode: create all the boxes already filled.
- Export to a text file or to the clipboard.
- English and Italian.

Open the planner from the Litematica material list (`M + L` → **Shulker Planner**), from the Litematica main menu, or with `M + B`.
